SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resumeId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, rbs.rbs_resume_name) AS name, u.phonenumber AS phone, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS jobName, 'web' AS source, rbs.rbs_created_at AS uploadTime FROM t_res_base rbs LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rbs.rbs_user_id
AND (IFNULL(u.nick_name, rbs.rbs_resume_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%'))
AND rbs.rbs_job_direction LIKE CONCAT('%', #{jobName}, '%')
AND 'web' = #{source}
ORDER BY rbs.rbs_created_at DESC, rbs.rbs_id DESC

SELECT rbs.rbs_id AS resumeId, IFNULL(u.nick_name, rbs.rbs_resume_name) AS name, u.phonenumber AS phone, u.email AS email, rbs.rbs_job_direction AS jobName, 'web' AS source, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS experience, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS workExperience, CAST(NULL AS CHAR) AS selfEval, rbs.rbs_created_at AS uploadTime FROM t_res_base rbs LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = rbs.rbs_user_id WHERE rbs.rbs_id = #{rbsId}
